title: Flying Machine Sky
hook: Build the flight idea one force and surface at a time.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D civilian aviation storybook, toy aircraft and ground gear, clean sky scenes; visual identity: Flying Machine Sky

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading an aircraft diagram
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Flying Machine Sky about aerodynamic/control roles: fuselage carries, wings lift, tail stabilizes, trim reduces control force, engines/propulsion move air; glider, kite, and zero-g aircraft show meaningful exceptions.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child builds a flight diagram from forces and control surfaces rather than treating every flying object as a plane with an engine.
